mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, price, category, size, material, eco_rating, carbon_footprint, recycled_content_percentage, water_usage, stock_quantity, image_url, brand, origin_country, is_certified_organic, is_fair_trade, is_active, created_at FROM products WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, name, description, price, category, size, material, eco_rating, carbon_footprint, recycled_content_percentage, water_usage, stock_quantity, image_url, brand, origin_country, is_certified_organic, is_fair_trade, is_active, created_at FROM products WHERE id = ? AND is_active = TRUE

SELECT id, name, description, price, category, size, material, eco_rating, carbon_footprint, recycled_content_percentage, water_usage, stock_quantity, image_url, brand, origin_country, is_certified_organic, is_fair_trade, is_active, created_at FROM products WHERE category = ? AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY eco_rating DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, name, description, price, category, size, material, eco_rating, carbon_footprint, recycled_content_percentage, water_usage, stock_quantity, image_url, brand, origin_country, is_certified_organic, is_fair_trade, is_active, created_at FROM products WHERE is_active = TRUE AND (name LIKE ? OR brand LIKE ? OR material LIKE ?) ORDER BY eco_rating DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, name, description, price, category, size, material, eco_rating, carbon_footprint, recycled_content_percentage, water_usage, stock_quantity, image_url, brand, origin_country, is_certified_organic, is_fair_trade, is_active, created_at FROM products WHERE is_active = TRUE AND eco_rating >= ? ORDER BY eco_rating DESC, price ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, category, size, material, eco_rating, carbon_footprint, recycled_content_percentage, water_usage, stock_quantity, image_url, brand, origin_country, is_certified_organic, is_fair_trade, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, TRUE, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET name = ?, description = ?, price = ?, category = ?, size = ?, material = ?, eco_rating = ?, carbon_footprint = ?, recycled_content_percentage = ?, water_usage = ?, stock_quantity = ?, image_url = ?, brand = ?, origin_country = ?, is_certified_organic = ?, is_fair_trade = ?, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?
UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? WHERE id = ? AND stock_quantity >= ?
UPDATE products SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = ?
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = TRUE
